predictions.statement: The pre-shuffle core plus application CRD pixel shuffle will be numerically identical to the canonical graph and permit the four Conv/Clip stages to be owned by XNNPACK.
The DCR rewrite will preserve output semantics; whether the Xiaomi NNAPI driver accepts the entire graph remains uncertain until strict device execution.

stopRules: Never overwrite or relabel the canonical ONNX model.
Do not call application pixel shuffle an execution-provider node.
Do not call NNAPI hardware execution proven unless NNAPI CPU is disabled and the profile has no ORT CPU nodes.
Keep any failed derivative, session or correctness result as negative evidence.
Do not use profiling latency as a publication benchmark.
